platform: First-person presentation principles; no platform-specific measurement
observations: Bungie's presentation identifies arms, weapons, and camera motion as the most persistent first-person motions.
The declared goal is high visual quality that supports design constraints and feels responsive and physical.
The source frames animation as support for embodiment rather than an isolated visual layer.
inferences: A first-person controller that moves correctly can still feel absent if camera, weapon, and body presentation do not describe the same motion.
Presentation must be evaluated against response and comfort instead of visual fidelity alone.
limits: The public overview does not expose every production technique or tuning value.
Audio and haptic conclusions require separate evidence and testing.
